name: WdOMathBreakBin
description: Specifies where Microsoft Word places binary operators when equations span two or more lines.

constants.name: wdOMathBreakBinBefore
constants.description: Places the operator after a line break, at the beginning of the following line.

constants.name: wdOMathBreakBinAfter
constants.description: Places the operator before a line break, at the end of the line.

constants.name: wdOMathBreakBinRepeat
constants.description: Repeats the operator before a line break at the end of the line and after a line break at the beginning of the following line.
